item.title: A layman’s guide to long duration energy storage
item.summary: Last year, for the first time in history, renewable energy produced more of the world’s electricity than coal. In the first half of 2025, solar and wind energy outstripped growth in global electricity demand and led to a small but significant reduction in the use of fossil fuels compared to the year before.
